requirement: The user shall be able to create new content maps using a supported computer during development.
The user shall be able to draft or edit later project sections on a checklist.
The user shall be able to make project Updates for the progress section status in review. Only this user marks the section.
The user shall be able to review feedback with revision notes or version history.
The user shall be able to assemble all the final deliverable project sections for completion.
The user shall be able to navigate between capstone sections using a simple sidebar or menu.
The user shall be able to view each section’s status (draft in-review final) at a glance.
source: Interview evidence about losing track of progress

requirement: The user shall be able to view a simple revision history for each section.
The users system shall auto-save section drafts every 30 seconds.
The user shall be able to reopen any previously saved draft.
The user shall be able to view a full project overview showing all sections and their statuses.
The user shall be able to follow a guided checklist for each section.
The user shall be able to see which sections depend on others.
The system shall warn the user when a section is missing required elements.
The user shall be able to tag sections with custom labels (e.g. research needs review).
The user shall be able to sort sections by status or tag.
The user shall be able to open a help panel explaining each feature.
The user shall be able to adjust basic settings (theme autosave interval).
The next maintainer shall be able to access documentation describing project structure and features.
The next maintainer shall be able to trace each requirement to its implementation.
The system shall include a configuration file for environment-specific settings.
The system shall include a basic test suite for core features.
Main project overview p95 load ≤ 2 s with 20 sections cold cache on normal laptop
measurement_method: browser DevTools cold cache 10 loads record p95

requirement: Saving a section draft completes in ≤ 1 s under normal conditions
measurement_method: 10 timed saves on same machine record times

requirement: Core workflow (create project → sections → draft → save → status → revision → assemble) produces zero unhandled errors
measurement_method: manual end-to-end run of core workflow record any unhandled error

requirement: A saved draft remains available after closing and reopening the application
measurement_method: save draft close app reopen verify content present

requirement: No passwords API keys access tokens or other secrets shall appear in any commit in the repository
measurement_method: secret scan over full history zero findings

requirement: User-entered section content shall never be executed as application code
measurement_method: attempt to enter script-like content verify it is stored and displayed as text only

requirement: Configuration files that contain environment-specific settings shall not contain secrets committed to the repo
measurement_method: inspect config files and history for any secrets

requirement: Every data element in the data inventory can be deleted by the user deleting the project or local data
measurement_method: create sample data delete project/local data verify elements are gone

requirement: Every interactive control is reachable and operable by keyboard alone with a visible focus indicator
measurement_method: manual pass mouse unplugged over the three core workflows

requirement: Body text meets ≥ 4.5:1 contrast ratio against its background
measurement_method: contrast checker on every text/background pair used

requirement: A first-time user completes the primary project-creation + first-section workflow without assistance in ≤ 5 minutes
measurement_method: two observed timed sessions notes recorded

requirement: A clean clone of the repository can be configured and launched using only the README in ≤ 10 minutes
measurement_method: clean-machine timed test once per iteration

requirement: The three core workflows function on the two most recent major versions of Chrome and Firefox
measurement_method: manual smoke test of three core flows on each browser/version
